bio: Housed within a mid-Victorian white stucco terrace, Number Sixteen is a chic boutique hotel set in the heart of beautiful South Kensington, and only moments from some of London's best museums.  Afternoon Tea can be served in their stunning tree-filled garden, or the hotel's vibrant Drawing Room or Library.  You can enjoy a selection of sandwiches, an array of delicious cakes, with the option to add a glass of champagne if you're in an extra indulgent mood!  Please note that each guest dining must order Afternoon Tea. One Afternoon Tea cannot be shared between two or more guests.
